description: A deck of cards the user swipes left or right one at a time, with buttons, undo and an empty state.
overview:
`CardStack` shows the top card of `data` with up to `visibleCount` cards stacked behind it, each slightly smaller and lower. Dragging the top card sideways moves and tilts it, while the cards behind grow into place.

Releasing past `threshold`, or flicking faster than 800 points per second, flies the card off in that direction and shows the next one; otherwise it springs back. Use it for one-at-a-time decisions such as keep or skip.
usage:
Pass `data` and `renderItem`, and handle `onSwipe(direction, item, index)`. Add children below the deck: `CardStackActions` with `CardStackSwipeButton`s and a `CardStackUndo`, and a `CardStackEmpty` shown once every card is swiped.

Undo brings back the last card from the side it left and calls `onUndo`. `useCardStack` exposes `index`, `count`, `remaining`, `canUndo`, `swipe` and `undo` for custom controls. The `CardStackDirection` type is exported.

examples.MidSwipe: A static frame of the top card dragged to the right.
examples.Disabled: Turns off swiping and the buttons with `disabled`.

parts.CardStack: The root that renders the deck and handles the drag gesture.
parts.CardStackEmpty: A dashed placeholder shown when no cards remain.
parts.CardStackActions: A centered row for the buttons.
parts.CardStackSwipeButton: A round button that swipes the top card left or right.
parts.CardStackUndo: A button that restores the last swiped card.

CardStack.data: The items to show as cards.
CardStack.renderItem: Renders one card from the item and its index.
CardStack.keyExtractor: Returns a key for a card. Defaults to its position.
CardStack.onSwipe: Called with the direction, item and index after a card leaves.
CardStack.onUndo: Called with the item and index after undo.
CardStack.threshold: Drag distance that commits a swipe. Defaults to `120`.
CardStack.visibleCount: Cards stacked behind the top card. Defaults to `3`.
CardStack.disabled: Turns off the gesture and the swipe buttons.
CardStack.itemAccessibilityLabel: Returns the label for the top card.
CardStack.deckClassName: Classes for the deck area, which is `h-96` by default.

CardStackSwipeButton.direction: `left` shows an X icon, `right` shows a heart icon.

accessibility:
- The top card has `Swipe left` and `Swipe right` accessibility actions.
- Cards behind the top card are hidden from screen readers.
- Swipe buttons are labelled `Swipe left` and `Swipe right`, and undo is labelled `Undo`, unless you pass `accessibilityLabel`.
notes:
- A medium impact haptic plays when a card is swiped by gesture, button or accessibility action, if the app provides an adapter through `HapticsProvider`.
- Fly-out and spring animations respect the system reduce motion setting.
- The left button icon uses `text-danger`; the right uses `text-accent`.
